# Cross Road updater 2.1.0 - Preview 1

Opt-in Windows preview. This prerelease does not replace the stable 2.0.1 download and is not automatically discovered by the stable updater channel.

**Already installed 2.0.1:** download `CrossRoad-Updater-Bootstrap-2.1.0-preview.zip`, extract all files, run `ADD UPDATER.cmd`, and choose your existing game directory containing `v1` and `Content`. It preserves the game URL, browser choice and dedicated profiles. The original owned desktop shortcut is backed up; the shortcut opens a panel with Play game, Check for updates, Update and Restore previous app.

**New installation:** download `KHUX-Windows-Setup-2.1.0-preview.zip`, extract it and run `START SETUP.cmd`. Installed Chrome or Edge is required. Setup retains the verified 2.0.1 content downloader and does not install a browser.

Updates require an explicit click, trusted repository release digests and per-file checks. Full dedicated-profile backups are verified before commit. Content and browser binaries are preserved. Interrupted commits recover before Play. Rollback restores app/runtime files without rewinding current saved progress. Long Windows backup paths are supported without changing system policies.

Close the game and fully exit its dedicated browser profile before updating. Edge may retain background processes after the window closes; the updater safely blocks an open profile and does not close personal browser windows.

Validation: 57 automated updater/bootstrap checks, isolated UI rendering and package integrity checks. The isolated copied-profile test verified actual process detection, full backup, local update and rollback, and original profile/content integrity. One additional post-update launch succeeded; all 31 persisted save records and all 11 cached assets matched the original data. **Visual in-game saved-state confirmation remains incomplete:** the captured game remained at its title screen and the test did not reach the save screen. This preview does not claim that check passed. Fresh installation and OS shortcut activation have not been exercised end to end either. No audio experiment, saves, test profiles, private logs, game content or browser binaries are included.

The package's local-preview labels record its build provenance. This GitHub release makes that audited preview available for manual opt-in; it is not a stable release.

**Release channel:** the application uses the repository's `releases/latest` stable endpoint and accepts numeric stable tags. It intentionally does not offer this prerelease. Install the preview bootstrap manually; a future stable version newer than desktop package 2.1.0 is needed to exercise automatic update discovery. `CrossRoad-Update.zip` and `CrossRoad-Update.json` are publisher/update payloads, not files to copy over your saves manually. Published public asset downloads and SHA256 digests are verified by the release workflow.

Verify downloads against the included `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Keep private backups under your game's `Setup/Updater/Backups` until you choose to remove them.
